XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Malfunction or sudden shutdown of the instrument panel
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: 74493 | ELECTRONICS | INSTRUMENTATION | VIDEO | SCREEN | BRIGHTNESS | DOES NOT TURN ON | DOES NOT START | OFF | DEACTIVATED | DOES NOT RESPOND | RESPONSE | DASHBOARD | COMPUTER | BOARD |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars manufactured in Novo Mesto from 20/11/18 to 07/10/21 or manufactured in Bursa from 30/05/18 to 06/10/21, equipped with a 7" instrument panel (MET04)

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Instrument panel control unit

  • Fault: Instrument panel malfunction, sudden shutdown of the display and inability to turn it on

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Instrument panel control unit software error

• Intervention: Perform reprogramming and software update of the instrument panel control unit via diagnosis

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: The software version to be installed in the instrument panel must be later than 06/10/21 for cars manufactured in Bursa, 07/10/21 for cars manufactured in Novo Mesto.
    Using a diagnostic tool, also check that all related systems are functioning correctly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
